steps.content:
For these two listings, you should buy from **Seller A - Ottervale Audio** - https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/qwfsk4/a

They are otherwise identical, so the authorized dealer status is the tie-breaker:

| | **A: Ottervale Audio** | **B: Brackmoor Sound** |
|---|---|---|
| **Product** | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - Graphite | Same |
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 / 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days | In stock. Free standard shipping, 3-5 business days |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. |
| **Warranty** | **1-year limited warranty + Explicitly states "Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."** | 1-year limited warranty - *no mention of being an authorized dealer* |

**Why Ottervale Audio is the safer choice:**

1.  **Guaranteed Authenticity & Full Warranty:** The listing specifically says "Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty." That means Quellwyn themselves recognize Ottervale as an official seller, so you are guaranteed a genuine new product and the full 1-year manufacturer warranty will be honored without issues.

2.  **Risk with Unauthorized Seller:** Brackmoor Sound makes no such claim. While it also lists a 1-year limited warranty, when a seller is not authorized it can mean grey-market stock, imported stock, or refurbished/open-box stock where the manufacturer may refuse warranty service and you'd have to rely only on the seller.

Since the price, shipping time, return policy, and ratings are exactly the same, there's no downside to choosing the authorized dealer - you get the same headphones for the same price/cost, but with significantly less risk if you need a warranty repair or replacement later.
